result.instructions: Tools for PiggyVest Business, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List our PiggyVest API wallets and their balances."; "Show the transactions from last week that failed."; "Check the name on account 0123456789 at bank code 058 before we pay it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PiggyVest Business data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run piggyvest_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run piggyvest_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run piggyvest_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. piggyvest_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_wallets
tools.title: List API wallets
tools.description: List the business's API wallets with the total balance (kobo) and a page of wallets. Good first call to find wallet ids. GET /api/v1/wallet/api/wallet-type.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's endCursor.

customer_id.description: Only wallets of this customer id.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_wallet
tools.title: Get a wallet
tools.description: Get one wallet: name, status, balance (kobo), interest rates and virtual account id. GET /api/v1/wallet/{wallet_id}.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_wallet_accounts
tools.title: Get wallet funding accounts
tools.description: List the bank account numbers that fund a wallet (virtual accounts with bank names). GET /api/v1/wallet/{wallet_id}/accounts.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_wallet_interest
tools.title: Get wallet interest accruals
tools.description: List stored interest accruals for a wallet over a date range (defaults to the current calendar month). GET /api/v1/wallet/interests/accrued/{wallet_id}.

start_date.description: Start of the accrual filter, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: End of the accrual filter, YYYY-MM-DD.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's endCursor.

search.description: Case-insensitive filter on the differential wallet name.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_banks
tools.title: List supported banks
tools.description: List the banks supported for transfers, with each bank's code. Use the code as bankCode in piggyvest_transfer_to_bank. GET /api/v1/transfer/bank-list.

tools.name: piggyvest_name_enquiry
tools.title: Resolve an account name
tools.description: Check the account holder name for a bank account before a transfer. Use it to confirm the payee. GET /api/v1/transfer/name-enquiry.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_transaction_status
tools.title: Check a transaction by reference
tools.description: Check the status (success, pending or failed) of a transfer by the reference you sent. Use it after a transfer to confirm the final result. GET /api/v1/transaction/verify.

reference.description: Your transaction reference (the reference you sent with the transfer).

wallet_id.description: Narrow the lookup to one wallet.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction by its PiggyVest id: amount, fee, status, wallets and balances after the move. GET /api/v1/transaction/{transaction_id}.

wallet_id.description: If set, the transaction must belong to this wallet.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List the business's transactions, newest first, with filters for wallet, status, direction, category and dates. GET /api/v1/transaction.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's endCursor.

collapse_batch.description: Set to "1" to merge batch rows for the list.

batch_transaction_id.description: A batch transaction id to summarise.

get_batch_info.description: Set to "1" with batch_transaction_id to add the batch summary.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers created through this API, with optional filters by your own id or the PiggyVest customer id. GET /api/v1/customers.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's endCursor.

third_party_identifier.description: Filter by your own internal customer id.

customer_id.description: Filter by the PiggyVest customer id.

tools.name: piggyvest_create_wallet
tools.title: Create an API wallet
tools.description: Create a new API wallet for a customer. Creation is asynchronous: the reply is only a wallet id, and the wallet is ready after a few minutes. POST /api/v1/wallet/sub-account.

reserve_virtual_account.description: True to create a funding virtual account for the wallet.

customer_id.description: The customer that owns the wallet (required for API wallets).

interest_payout_wallet.description: Wallet id that receives interest payouts.

tools.name: piggyvest_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a business customer and its default wallet. Sends personal identity data (BVN) to PiggyVest for verification: send only what the customer agreed to share. POST /api/v1/customers.

bvn.description: The customer's Bank Verification Number, exactly 11 digits.

third_party_identifier.description: Your own stable id for this customer.

interest_payout_wallet.description: Wallet id that receives interest payouts.

enable_interest_accrual.description: False disables interest on the new customer.

returnIfExist.description: True: return the existing customer instead of an error when one matches.

tools.name: piggyvest_reserve_account
tools.title: Reserve a virtual account
tools.description: Reserve a bank account number for a wallet. A regular account stays active; a disposable account expires after the expiry minutes. POST /api/v1/wallet/reserve-account.

name.description: Account name shown to the payer.

code.description: Bank code for the account, if the business needs one.

amount.description: Disposable only: expected amount in kobo.

payment_policy.description: Disposable only: how to handle payments that differ from amount.

error_margin.description: Disposable only: allowed difference from amount, in kobo.

tools.name: piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets
tools.title: Transfer between wallets
tools.description: MOVES MONEY: transfer kobo from one of this business's wallets to another. Needs confirm=true. The reply is 202 (processing): check the result with piggyvest_get_transaction_status. Do not retry with the same reference; check it first. POST /api/v1/transfer/wallet.

amount.description: Amount in kobo (NGN x 100), a positive integer. 100000 kobo = NGN 1,000.

source.description: Source wallet id. This wallet is debited.

destination.description: Destination wallet id. This wallet is credited.

reference.description: Your unique reference for this transfer. Keep it to check the status.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user approves this exact transfer. The tool refuses to run without it.

tools.name: piggyvest_transfer_to_bank
tools.title: Transfer to a bank account
tools.description: MOVES MONEY: send kobo from a wallet to an external bank account. Call piggyvest_name_enquiry first. Needs confirm=true. The reply is 202 (processing): check the result with piggyvest_get_transaction_status. Do not retry with the same reference; check it first. POST /api/v1/transfer/bank.

amount.description: Amount in kobo (NGN x 100), a positive integer. 100000 kobo = NGN 1,000.

source.description: Source wallet id. This wallet is debited.

reference.description: Your unique reference for this transfer. Keep it to check the status.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user approves this exact transfer. The tool refuses to run without it.

tools.name: piggyvest_schedule_payment
tools.title: Schedule a payment
tools.description: SCHEDULES A FUTURE PAYMENT: a one-time or recurring transfer from a wallet to a wallet or bank account. Needs confirm=true. Cancel it later with piggyvest_set_schedule_payment_active. POST /api/v1/transfer/schedule-payment.

amount.description: Amount in kobo (NGN x 100), a positive integer. 100000 kobo = NGN 1,000.

start_date.description: First run, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, in the future.

frequency.description: How often the payment runs. Required by the API.

destination_id.description: Destination wallet id, or the bank account number when destination_type is bank.

destination_code.description: Bank code, required when destination_type is bank.

end_date.description: Last run for a recurring payment, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user approves this exact transfer. The tool refuses to run without it.

tools.name: piggyvest_set_schedule_payment_active
tools.title: Cancel or reactivate a scheduled payment
tools.description: Set a scheduled payment active or inactive. is_active=false cancels it (no more runs). is_active=true reactivates it and needs confirm=true. A payment whose end date has passed cannot be reactivated. PATCH /api/v1/transfer/schedule-payment/{schedule_payment_id}.

schedule_payment_id.description: The schedule payment id returned by piggyvest_schedule_payment.

is_active.description: false to cancel, true to reactivate.

confirm.description: Required only to reactivate (is_active=true): reactivation schedules future transfers. Not needed to cancel.

annotations.title: Cancel or reactivate a scheduled payment
